description: This file defines the EntityForm class, a base class for entity forms in Drupal, implementing form building, processing, entity management, and hook invocation.

classes.name: EntityForm
classes.description: A base class for entity forms in Drupal, providing common form handling, entity management, and hook invocation functionalities.

methods.name: setOperation
methods.description: Sets the current operation name for the form.

methods.name: getBaseFormId
methods.description: Returns the base form ID, used for form alter hooks.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Generates and returns the unique form ID based on entity type and operation.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form array, initializing form state and adding cacheability metadata.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes form state and prepares the entity before the first build.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Returns the form array with process and after_build callbacks added.

methods.name: processForm
methods.description: Process callback to restore entity reference when form is cached.

methods.name: afterBuild
methods.description: Updates the entity with submitted data during form rebuilds.

methods.name: actionsElement
methods.description: Generates the actions element with submit and delete buttons.

methods.name: actions
methods.description: Provides supported actions (save, delete) for the form.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, updating the entity.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the entity.

methods.name: buildEntity
methods.description: Constructs the entity object from form values.

methods.name: getCallableFromDefinition
methods.description: Resolves a callable from a string or array definition, using the service container if available.

methods.name: copyFormValuesToEntity
methods.description: Copies top-level form values to the entity properties.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the current entity.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the entity for the form.

methods.name: getEntityFromRouteMatch
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an entity based on route parameters.

methods.name: prepareEntity
methods.description: Prepares the entity object before form building.

methods.name: prepareInvokeAll
methods.description: Invokes all modules' hooks for a given hook name.

methods.name: getOperation
methods.description: Returns the current operation.

methods.name: setModuleHandler
methods.description: Sets the module handler service.

methods.name: setEntityTypeManager
methods.description: Sets the entity type manager service.
